declaration.hidden_update_rule: Each cell appears to carry a one-bit refractory/parity memory that flips when the cell is alive and changes which neighbor-count transitions are allowed on the next step.
declaration.mechanism: The visible dynamics are local and translation-invariant on the 32x32 torus, depending on the 8-neighborhood plus that hidden per-cell bit; the same visible pattern can recur with different successors (as seen with an identical plus shape at two times), so the rule is effectively a two-phase Life-like cellular automaton rather than a first-order rule on visible cells alone.
